scientific_scope: A fixed homogeneous binary order-two Markov-mixture law with arbitrary source-dependent initial distribution and independent full labeled training episodes.

A legal attack sees the history but not the current latent source or future label; its fresh randomness is conditionally independent of them given history and fixed training information. Conditional expectation precedes the history-wise maximum.

For square loss, legal supervised risk and true-source risk have the same predictor ranking up to distinct additive constants. An exact Bernoulli(1/5) example reverses the ranking under label-visible edits.

Initial pair, final pair and transition counts determine the conditional predictive mean. Flow reconstruction gives at most 16(M+1)^4 groups. This is a direct specialization of classical Markov sufficiency.

A fixed finite predictor class and two independent samples yield a conservative offline excess-risk bound via elementary occupancy, Markov, Hoeffding and union bounds. It may be vacuous and is not a novel generic statistical principle.

Known k is used in enumerating legal edits. B can be exponential; predictor cost, exact arithmetic and storage are charged separately. No SGD, learned attention, finite-precision training, worst-source or unknown-budget guarantee is established.

Optional ACG comparator transfer requires its full all-state certificate, M>=64, beta>=1/M, exact statistics/output and inclusion in the finite class. The absolute-loss transfer loses a square root and may be vacuous.
Scoped literature checks are abstracts/metadata, not theorem-by-theorem coverage or novelty certification. The review is an independent LLM scientific audit, not external peer review or formal proof.
finite_checks: Three author and one independent standard-library rational scripts; all seven archived logs retained. They do not replace the general proof. Six genuine before/diff/successor edges retained.
